# voipcom System

> Business telecom for Pakistan, built and billed in Pakistan. Four services on one cloud phone system: call center solutions, cloud PBX, business automation (order-confirmation calls, AI voice agents, WhatsApp/CRM workflows), and Pakistani DID numbers with SIP delivery for AI voice agents (Retell, Vapi, Bland). No hardware, live in a day, works with PTA-licensed operators, plans from PKR 2,900/month. Registered company: Voipcom System (Pvt) Ltd.

## Services (landing pages)
- [Call center solutions in Pakistan](https://voipcomsystem.com/call-center.html): Cloud dialer (predictive/progressive/preview), IVR, queues, recording, live supervisor dashboard, remote agents. Pilot team live in 24 hours.
- [Cloud PBX](https://voipcomsystem.com/cloud-pbx.html): One business number, unlimited extensions, Urdu/English IVR, call recording, reports, mobile app. Replaces the PABX box and per-employee SIMs.
- [Business automation](https://voipcomsystem.com/automation.html): Automated COD order-confirmation calls, AI voice agents for after-hours and overflow, WhatsApp follow-ups, CRM sync.
- [Pakistani DIDs for AI agents](https://voipcomsystem.com/ai-phone-numbers.html): 021/042/051 numbers with SIP trunking that plug into Retell, Vapi, Bland and custom stacks.
- [Pricing](https://voipcomsystem.com/pricing.html): PKR plans from 2,900/month; call centers and automation priced per seat/call.
- [Book a demo](https://voipcomsystem.com/contact.html)
